about: S4 城門口外 (part 1): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; lines from gen/life/vignettes_S4_S6.md and the readings). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips (sleepers only think). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 臨街神算
scenes.reading: 名画记 28: divination was a huge trade; a diviner boasted '士大夫的命运，在我可否之间', perhaps why this one sits by an official's hall. 余辉 2014 临街神算. The painted signs read 神課 and 看命.

teller.name: 賣卦先生
teller.src: 名画记 28 算命先生, in the Song 话本 word 卖卦先生

onlooker.name: 閒人
onlooker.src: the onlooker with his arm up at the signs (map)

beats.say_en: Read your fate? Settle a doubt?
beats.src: vignettes V4.2, near line from the painted signs

as.shi: 這位相公，可要問問功名？
as.fu: 娘子問姻緣，還是問子嗣？

as_en.guan: Please sit, sir. A look at your prospects?
as_en.shi: Young scholar, ask about the exams?
as_en.fu: Madam, is it marriage you ask about, or children?
as_en.tong: Little one, here for a reading too?
as_en.seng: You believe in this too, Master?
as_en.jun: Soldier, ask when you'll be relieved?
as_en.li: Brother, ask about this year's living?

beats.say: 先生，我這趟買賣做得成麼？
beats.say_en: Master, will this deal of mine come off?

beats.say: 看你這氣色，今年必有一番進益。
beats.say_en: By your colour, you'll get ahead this year.
Divine lessons. He's good.

beats.think: 士大夫的命運，在我可否之間。
beats.think_en: The fortunes of officials hang on my yes or no.

beats.say_en: Back again? What is it this time?

as_en.guan: What else would you ask, sir?
as_en.shi: Still asking about the exams, sir?

beats.say: 城門口稅重，這趟還划得來麼？
beats.say_en: With the gate tax so heavy, is the trip still worth it?
beats.src: our proposal (the tax thread, after 余辉 2023's quarrel at the gate)

beats.say_en: Hard first, easy after. Don't fret.
He said that last time too.

beats.say: 我這幾塊招牌：決疑、看命、神課。
beats.say_en: My signs: settle doubts, read fates, divine lessons.
beats.src: the painted signs 決□, 看命, 神課 (map; 決疑 is our reading of the first)

beats.say: 這攤子挨著官衙，倒會挑地方。
beats.say_en: Set up by the office: he knows where to sit.
beats.src: 名画记 28 (perhaps why he sits by the official hall)

scenes.title: 懶兵候主
scenes.reading: 余辉 2015: soldiers of a courier detail sit and lie by two document boxes, kept waiting till worn out; they should have left at dawn, it is nearly noon and the official has not come out; a well-fed white horse lies in the yard. 名画记 29: a 递铺 passing court documents, set outside the gate so couriers can rest when it shuts at night; '一个个都显得十分疲乏'. Hansen: dozing guards of a yamen. Chosen: 余辉's courier post with 名画记's 递铺.

box.name: 軍士
box.src: the round-faced soldier squatting behind the document box, looking out at the viewer (map; 余辉 2015)

stool.name: 軍士
stool.src: the bearded soldier on a stool by the gate (map)

kneeup.name: 軍士
kneeup.src: the stocky soldier hugging one knee (map)

lying.name: 軍士
lying.src: the soldier asleep at the willow's foot (map)

beats.say_en: What are you staring at? The papers aren't out yet.
beats.src: vignettes V4.1 near line (he looks straight out at the viewer, 余辉 2015)

as.jun: 兄弟哪個鋪的？也在等差？
as.fu: 娘子，這是遞鋪，閒人莫近。

as_en.guan: Sir, have you come to hurry the papers?
as_en.jun: Which post are you from, brother? Waiting too?
as_en.seng: Master, there's no alms food here.
as_en.fu: Madam, this is the courier post. Keep away.

beats.say: 天不亮就該走了，差官還不出來。
beats.say_en: We should have left before dawn. The official still hasn't come out.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (they should have left at dawn; it is nearly noon)

beats.say_en: No use fretting. Wait.

beats.src: 名画记 29 (一个个都显得十分疲乏); the map (asleep)

beats.say: 你若無事，也坐下歇歇罷。
beats.say_en: If you've nothing to do, sit and rest.

as.guan: 官人若見著差官，替咱催一催。

as_en.guan: Sir, if you see the officer, hurry him for us.
as_en.jun: Sit down too. We're all waiting anyway.

beats.say_en: Back again? Hands off the chest.

beats.say: 箱裏是遞往外地的公文。
beats.say_en: The chest holds papers for the provinces.
beats.src: 名画记 29 (a 递铺 passing court documents to the provinces)

beats.say: 城門夜裏一關，就在這裏歇。
beats.say_en: When the gate shuts at night, couriers rest here.
beats.src: 名画记 29 (set outside the gate for when it shuts at night)

scenes.title: 筐前問價
scenes.reading: The map: a stall under two mat awnings and a light parasol, a huge basket of heaped brown goods (straw, hemp or brushwood); men lean over and bend toward it, one raises his arm, a man in a dark robe and a child look on. No published reading; the haggle is our proposal (vignettes V4.5).

waving.name: 攤主
waving.src: the man raising his arm at the basket (map; vignettes V4.5)

leaner.name: 買主
leaner.src: the man leaning over the big basket (map)

bearded.name: 買主
bearded.src: the bearded man bending toward the basket (map)

child.name: 孩童
child.src: the child beside the man in the dark robe (map)

father.name: 行人
father.src: the man in a long dark robe beside the child (map; the kinship is ours)

beats.say_en: Over here! Another basket!

as_en.guan: Sir, pick a basket, delivered to your house?
as_en.li: Brother, this basket's cheap for you.

beats.say_en: How much for this basket?
Is it dry? Not damp, is it?
Sun-dried for days. Bone dry.
What are those hanging things?
beats.src: vignettes V4.5 (the round things hanging under the parasol)

beats.say_en: Only these few baskets left today.
Daddy, I want that one!
beats.src: our proposal (the child at the basket)

beats.say_en: Don't point. Watch the road.

scenes.title: 牛車遇騎
scenes.reading: 名画记 31: two big covered ox carts go fast, perhaps a rich family's; at the corner a horseman comes straight at them, '情景甚为紧张'. The map: the carter with the whip beyond the second cart is painted mouth open; the fan rider and his groom squeeze past the first cart's rear.

whip.name: 車夫
whip.src: the carter with a whip, mouth open (map; 名画记 31)

groom.name: 馬夫
groom.src: the young groom at the fan rider's horse (map)

rider.name: 騎客
rider.src: the rider shading his face with a round fan (map)

driver.name: 車夫
driver.src: the driver bending at the shaft ox (map)

beats.say_en: Step aside, young man!

as_en.fu: Madam, stand aside. Don't get hit.

beats.say_en: Rein in, sir! Keep to the side!
beats.src: vignettes V4.3 (the groom to his rider; 名画记 31's horseman)

beats.say_en: Whoa — slow down.
You again? Don't block the road this time.

as_en.guan: You again, sir. The cart is passing now.

beats.say_en: This horse panics at the sight of oxen.
beats.src: the map (the fan rider's horse, head down); our proposal

beats.say: 兩頭牛拉著，說停可停不住。
beats.say_en: Two oxen pulling: easy to say stop, hard to do.
beats.src: the map (a shaft ox and a lead ox pull the second cart); 名画记 31 (the carts go fast)

scenes.title: 抬轎進城
scenes.reading: The map: two tall sedan chairs carried west toward the city, bearers lifting and shouldering the poles, one straining between the chairs, a man in a long robe walking at the west chair. No passenger is painted, so none speaks. Lines: vignettes V4.4 (our proposal).

robe.src: the man in a long robe walking at the west sedan (map; steward is our reading)

strain.name: 轎夫
strain.src: the bearer straining under the poles, mouth open (map)

bend.name: 轎夫
bend.src: the front bearer bending to the pole ends (map)

beats.say_en: Lift gently. Don't jolt the one inside.

as_en.guan: After you, sir. The chairs will wait.

beats.say_en: Hup — steady!
beats.src: vignettes V4.4 (the straining bearer, painted mouth open)

beats.say_en: Up!
Into town before the gate shuts.
beats.src: our proposal (they travel west, toward the gate)

beats.say_en: Who's in the chair is none of your business.

as.guan: 官人見諒，主家不便見客。

as_en.guan: Pardon, sir, the household cannot receive you.

beats.say_en: The city gate is just ahead.
beats.src: the map (the chairs are carried west, toward the gate)

beats.say_en: Hup — my shoulder's rubbed raw.
beats.src: the map (the bearer straining under the poles, mouth open)

say: 城門口稅重，這趟買賣做得成麼？
貨到城門，稅就去了一半。
say_en: The gate tax is heavy. Will my deal come off?

beats.src: our proposal (the tax thread; vignettes V4.2's client)

say_en: Patience. Let me cast a reading.
Wait. First, the hour of your birth.
The lesson says: hard first, easy after.
The reading says: past this, all is well.
Listen to him. You can't go wrong.

say: 看你這氣色，今年必有進益。
